Folks —

Thanks for the fast turn on evidence. This is the consolidated decision set heading into tomorrow’s calibration:

1) Acme renewal uplift — Accept CS note + December PS invoices as sufficient evidence. AR reconciliation marked pending (low risk).
2) Latency objective — Re-weighted customer-impact to 40% as per Irene; score adjusted to reflect incident impact (see final_scoring_v2.xlsx).
3) Two technical flags (rows 18–19) — Escalated to exec. Ben, please capture a one-paragraph position from infra owners before the calibration.
4) Communication plan — We’ll send a short note to affected PMs and CSMs after the call; for Acme, coordinate with Peter on messaging and attach the evidence we received.

Attachments: final_scoring_v2.xlsx (consolidated ledger)
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQ4QBR_closure_docs — finalized evidence is in the /handback folder.

Meeting: Exec calibration — Sat, May 15 09:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Please have one-sentence rationales for any positions you intend to defend.

If no objections by 09:00 tomorrow we’ll publish the scores and close the quarter.
